notes.title: Advanced Achievements and Gluttony Boss Fix
notes.content:
*Added Settings in pause menu
*Added Settings for camera sensitivity, audio, and quality
*Fixed Gluttony Boss being unkillable
*Fixed Tank not spawning after Gluttony is hurt twice
*Added Note on how to defeat Gluttony in his level

**Note** Camera sensitivity and audio settings can be a little buggy, if they dont work try restarting the game.

ABOUT THE SLOTH CHAPTER: The next chapter releasing for my game is the Sloth chapter, 3 new levels, npcs to talk and interact with, cutscenes, optional bosses, mini bosses, and a new antagonist. Ive been hard at work to get it out and It should release sometime around or after October. I just started college so things have been a little stressful but I hope you guys can look forward to it. 

Also dont forget to leave reviews, comments, screenshots, or anything I love to see or read what people do in my game.

notes.title: The maybe fix
notes.content: Because ue5 is wacky this update either fixes the achievements allowing people to get it or, the more likley one, does nothing. But i did add some fun stuff like a hallway jumpscare and ceiling man in the store level.

notes.title: Achievment Update
notes.content:
*Added Achievments to game (Harder to earn achievments coming in a further update)
*Fixed start game button saying create server
*Fixed the strongman not spawing when 2nd phase of gluttony fight
*Fixed gluttony never dying after 3 hits
*Added more light bombs to neighborhood level
*Added a note to explain how to kill Gluttony

notes.title: Quick Fix
notes.content: *Fixed the game showing a black screen.

notes.title: Escape menu
notes.content:
*Added an escape menu to resume, return to main menu, or quit the game.
*Added option to toggle camera effect
*Removed bright Loading screen png that really does nothing
*Removed a couple models that increased the loading time
*Fixed a couple notes freezing the game

Note: On higher quality settings the textures for levels takes longer to load. Also, somtimes the when returning to the main menu through the escape menu the game might crash.

notes.title: Quality Update
notes.content:
*Added ability to change quality at start of the game
*Added Notes for lore in levels
*Improved textures for first level
*Adding loading screens
Note: With the quality settings in place some textures MIGHT take a while to load. So you might see missing textures though they should fix themselves upon waiting a set time.
